description: Use for an exact SAIKYO quote from RUB via SBP QR (Omega Wallet) to USDT. Returns the live Omega Wallet rate, network fee, amounts, limits, reserve and order link.

amount.description: Amount in the currency chosen by amount_side (default: rubles the user pays).

amount_side.description: Whether amount is the amount paid (give) or received (get). Defaults to give.

from_code.description: Currency the user pays. Defaults to RUB (rubles via SBP QR).

to_code.description: Currency the user receives. Defaults to USDTTRC20 (USDT on TRON); also USDTTON, USDTPOLYGON, USDTBEP20, USDTERC20.

name: calculate_exchange
title: Calculate a SAIKYO exchange
